name: Akina Akitsuki
source: A bright and cheerful girl that loves cute things. Akina a hardworker but because everyone around her is gifted, she carries feelings of inferiority. Quite normal and average in everything outside of her boob size. When agitated, she swings her fists around while yelling "idiooooot".
